_doc: Per-feed manifest (Phase 1 §1i / §2 contract). One row per raw feed file mapping it to {feed, group, dialect, log_flag}. 'dialect' is ONLY the ReferencePipeline oracle's own per-line CSV-type tag (hosts/plain/abp), simulating the pre-ADR-62 PHP loop it re-implements -- production build()'s manifest carries no such field (#1083 P4 retired format_hint end-to-end); the oracle uses it to drive the reference preprocessor in the same order the current pipeline concatenates feeds.
